# Home

## Websites and reports that say what they mean

Fernhill & Co is a small studio. We work with a handful of clients at a time, so you always talk to the people
doing the work.

## What we do

**Websites.** Pages that load quickly on a phone and say plainly what you offer. Most of our sites are a few static
pages that cost little to host and need nothing patched.

**Reports.** Annual and quarterly reports with the figures laid out clearly and a written summary anyone can read
in five minutes.

**Case studies.** We help you show your own work: what the client asked for, what you did, and what changed.

## Recent work

Harbour Bakery · Northgate Library · Calder Joinery — [see the work](/work)

## Get in touch

Tell us what you need in a few lines and we'll reply within two working days.
[Write to us](/contact)
